hard_gates: specific 2027-2028 population and positive planned size
clear workforce challenge and AI use case
responsible-AI safeguards and meaningful worker voice
direct workforce track record OR committed partner track record
non_authority: RFI response is not an award
PARTNER_RFI readiness is not partner consent unless commitment evidence is supplied
no status authorizes contact, submission, participant-data access, contract, spend, or revenue recognition

route_definitions.DIRECT_RFI: Owner evidence establishes an AIR-relevant workforce-delivery track record for the submitting organization.
route_definitions.HOLD: Core RFI content, source freshness, evidence integrity, or claim support is incomplete.
route_definitions.PARTNER_REQUIRED: The concept is coherent enough to pursue, but neither direct track record nor a committed track-record-bearing partner is evidenced.
route_definitions.PARTNER_RFI: A committed workforce-delivery partner supplies the track record, served population, and delivery relationship while the technology contribution remains bounded.
